YOUJIN_CARD_BLOOD_SACRIFICE.title: Blood Sacrifice
YOUJIN_CARD_BLOOD_SACRIFICE.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].
All teammates lose {HpLoss:diff()} HP.
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} and draw {Cards:diff()} cards.
YOUJIN_CARD_BURN_IT_ALL.title: Burn It All
YOUJIN_CARD_BURN_IT_ALL.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].
[gold]Exhaust[/gold] your hand and every teammate's hand.
Deal {Damage:diff()} damage for each card exhausted.
YOUJIN_CARD_TEAMMATES_GO_FIRST.title: Teammates Go First
YOUJIN_CARD_TEAMMATES_GO_FIRST.descripti:
Choose a teammate.
You take {DamageDecrease:percentLess()}% less damage from enemies.
That teammate takes {DamageIncrease:percentMore()}% more damage from enemies.
YOUJIN_CARD_FULL_CONCENTRATION.title: Full Concentration
YOUJIN_CARD_FULL_CONCENTRATION.descripti:
Each teammate randomly [gold]discards[/gold] a card.
Gain {Energy:energyIcons()} for each card discarded.
YOUJIN_CARD_SPARKS_FLY.title: Sparks Fly
YOUJIN_CARD_SPARKS_FLY.description:
[gold]Forge[/gold] {Forge:diff()}.
Add a [gold]Debris[/gold] to every other player's hand.
YOUJIN_CARD_LEND_IT_TO_ME.title: Lend It To Me
YOUJIN_CARD_DARK_MAGIC.title: Dark Magic
YOUJIN_CARD_DARK_MAGIC.description:
All teammates gain {DoomPower:diff()} [gold]Doom[/gold].
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Soul[/gold] cards to your hand.
YOUJIN_CARD_TABOO_FORCE.title: Forbidden Power
YOUJIN_CARD_TABOO_FORCE.description:
[gold]Exhaust[/gold].
All teammates gain [gold]Borrowed Time[/gold]: cards cost {ExtraCost:energyIcons()} more this turn.
All cards in your hand gain [gold]Replay[/gold] {Replay:diff()}.
YOUJIN_CARD_TRANSFER_ENERGY.title: Transfer Energy
YOUJIN_CARD_CORRECT_COGNITION.title: Correct Cognition
YOUJIN_CARD_CORRECT_COGNITION.descriptio:
Double your [gold]Focus[/gold].
Add {Cards:diff()} [gold]Wound[/gold] cards to every other player's hand.
